entities.summary: Travis Takashi Ishikawa is an American former professional baseball first baseman and current minor league coach. He played for the San Francisco Giants, Milwaukee Brewers, Baltimore Orioles, New York Yankees, and Pittsburgh Pirates. Ishikawa has also filled in as an outfielder at times in his career.
